title: AITA for getting upset at a friend?
question: AITA for getting upset at a friend?
body:
Yesterday I entered a contest where the winner gets a nice cash price for getting the most likes on a comment on an Instagram post. I really wanted to win so I messaged a couple of friends asking to like my comment so I could win. I messaged one of my close friends, and instead of liking my comment, she posted her own comment on the post and started messaging her friends and asking to like her comment. She went as far as creating fake accounts to like her own comment. She even admitted so to me when I confronted her. 

She did not follow this blogger before, and would not have heard of this contest had it not been for me. I spoke to her and told her it made me upset that she did this to me since I specifically asked for her support. She’s currently winning the contest. She says she doesn’t see the issue whatsoever. I blocked her on all social media and don’t see myself being friends with someone like this. AITA for acting this way?


TLDR; I entered a contest, asked my friend for support, and she entered the contest herself without even voting for me.
